description:
High school student Kang Jae-Yeong’s biggest worry is how to get by on just one meal a day. His secret is sneaking off to a free meal center to fill his stomach. That day, Kang Jae-Yeong stopped by the meal center to eat, only to accidentally witness two students from a nearby prestigious high school kissing. The problem is that they’re both boys. Caught in an embarrassing moment, Yeon Min-Gyeol angrily demands that a stunned Kang Jae-Yeong keep his secret in exchange for money. After their disastrous first encounter, the two keep running into each other for some reason. Although Yeon Min-Gyeol gets on his nerves, their meetings continue—meetings that are hard to refuse.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: The twelfth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.*
